Are you preparing for UPSC CSE 2028 with Sociology as your Optional Subject?

Choosing the right optional strategy and starting your preparation at the right time can make a significant difference to your UPSC journey.

To help you get started, Sarrthi IAS brings you an Orientation Session on Sociology Foundation for UPSC CSE 2028, under the guidance of Pranay Aggarwal Sir (16+ Years of Experience).

In this session, you will get insights into:
📚Understanding Sociology Optional and its relevance in UPSC CSE.
📚Understanding the Sociology syllabus and its structure.
📚How to approach Sociology Paper 1 and Paper 2.
📚The importance of conceptual clarity and answer writing.
📚Integrating Current Affairs with Sociology Optional.
📚Building the right preparation strategy for UPSC CSE 2028.
📚How to begin your Sociology preparation with a structured approach.

Whether you are just starting your UPSC preparation or have already begun your journey, this session will help you understand Sociology Optional better and plan your preparation effectively.

Start your Sociology preparation with the right guidance and strategy!

📚 Sociology Foundation for UPSC CSE 2028
👨‍🏫 Faculty: Pranay Aggarwal Sir
🎓 Experience: 16+ Years

We celebrated our first anniversary in the Maldives, and it turned into one of the most heartfelt and adventurous trips we have filmed, full of ocean calm, big laughs and honest conversations about what a year together really feels like.

From slow mornings to days spent in and around the water, we stepped out of our comfort zone, tried new things together and soaked in the island life. Even the rain could not take away from the magic of the place.

We also look back at how our story began, what the first year has taught us, and why no relationship is ever perfect. We end the trip with a little anniversary celebration and a lot of gratitude.

This is just the beginning of our Life Of Rahi series. There is a lot more still to come, so keep following along.
